introTitle: Comrade, Stop Sending 12t Dumpers for Two Wheelbarrows of Gravel!
introBody:
Do your Construction Offices keep dispatching massive 12-tonne trucks for 1.8 tonnes of remaining bricks, or 40-seat buses when a construction phase only needs 2 workdays to finish? And do five trucks jam the same road node at once?

By decree of the [b]Supreme Soviet Construction Logistics Directorate[/b], [b]CODispatchControl[/b] teaches Construction Offices to match vehicle sizes to actual remaining site demand and cap simultaneous trucks per construction site — while [b]never[/b] blocking excavators, cranes, bulldozers, or flatbed carriers.
operatingSection:
[h1]Operating CO Dispatch Control (In-Game)[/h1][list]
[*] Press [b]F9[/b] anytime in-game to open [b]WRSR Tweaks [F9][/b] -> [b]CO Dispatch[/b] tab (or [b]Esc[/b] to close).
[*] [b]Min Material Truck Fill %[/b] (0% - 100%, default 50%): Rejects oversized material trucks when [i]remaining_phase_material / vehicle_capacity[/i] is below threshold and a smaller capable truck exists in the CO. Final top-offs below [i]1.5t[/i] are automatically exempted.
[*] [b]Min Bus Workday Ratio[/b] (0.0 - 2.0, default 0.5): Prevents dispatching large buses when [i]remaining_workdays < bus_capacity * ratio[/i] if a smaller bus or microbus exists in the CO.
[*] [b]Max Trucks En Route per Site[/b] (1 - 10, default 2): Caps simultaneous material trucks heading to the same construction site to prevent road-node traffic jams.
[*] [b]Quick Presets:[/b] [i]Vanilla[/i], [i]Balanced[/i], and [i]Strict[/i] buttons apply recommended settings immediately.
[*] [b]Save Config (Ctrl+S):[/b] Writes settings to [i]CODispatchControl.ini[/i] beside the plugin DLL.
[/list]
examplesSection:
[h1]Recommended Settings by Play-Style[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Balanced (default):[/b] Fill 50%, Bus Ratio 0.50, Max Trucks 2. Big trucks handle bulk deliveries; small trucks and microbuses take finish-up shifts.
[*] [b]Strict (anti-congestion):[/b] Fill 75%, Bus Ratio 1.00, Max Trucks 1. Tightly eliminates road-node queues around busy construction zones.
[*] [b]Vanilla:[/b] Click the [i]Vanilla[/i] preset (0% / 0.00 / 10) to restore unmodded CO dispatch.
[/list]
guaranteesSection:
[h1]Five-Year Plan Guarantees (Save-Safe & Lightweight)[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Mechanism & Flatbed Safe:[/b] Excavators, bulldozers, cranes, and flatbed carrier dispatches are [b]never[/b] blocked.
[*] [b]No Deadlocks:[/b] Fill-threshold and bus-ratio checks automatically exempt a vehicle if the CO has no smaller capable vehicle, or if remaining material is under [i]1.5t[/i].
[*] [b]100% Save-Safe:[/b] Settings live cleanly in [i]CODispatchControl.ini[/i] next to the DLL (binary WRSR saves are never modified).
[/list]
companionModsSection:
[h1]Companion Mods (Logistics Suite)[/h1][list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3845998630][b]SmartDOBatching[/b][/url] - Prevent Distribution Offices from dispatching near-empty trucks or trains via the same [b]F9[/b] overlay.
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3845944617][b]CustomsSpeedControl[/b][/url] - Scale Customs House cargo Load & Unload speeds live via [b]F9[/b].
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3845533384][b]TradePriceLimits[/b][/url] - Set min-sell / max-buy price limits on Distribution Office border transfers ([b]F8[/b]).
[/list]
